description:
Updates the allocation balance for the Project Entitlement identified by the `funding_source_id` and `project_id` composite key. This endpoint reuses the existing project entitlement update contract and only supports mutable entitlement fields documented here.
Requires the `update_project_entitlements` granular permission on the Funding Sources tool.

parameters.name: funding_source_id
parameters.description: Unique string identifier of the funding source. Use in project-entitlement and project-usage paths under `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/funding_sources/{funding_source_id}/`.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique string identifier of the project. Combined with `{funding_source_id}` this is the composite key for show and update. Must belong to the same company as the funding source.

data.description: A project entitlement — an allocation of funds from a funding source to a single project. Identified by the composite of `funding_source` and `project`.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the entitlement. Note that show and update are addressed by the composite `{funding_source_id}`/`{project_id}` path, not by this id.

funding_source.description: Funding source this entitlement draws from. Use nested `id` as `{funding_source_id}` on entitlement endpoints.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the funding source. Use as `{funding_source_id}` on `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/funding_sources/{funding_source_id}/project_entitlements`.

number.description: Human-readable funding source number, unique within the company.

name.description: Display name of the funding source.

project.description: Project receiving the allocation. Use nested `id` as `{project_id}` on show and update.

id.description: Unique string identifier of the project. Use as `{project_id}` on GET and PATCH `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/funding_sources/{funding_source_id}/project_entitlements/{project_id}`.

allocation_balance.description: Amount of the funding source allocated to this project in the funding source's currency. Always non-negative. Returned with exactly 2 fractional digits.

version.description: Monotonic version counter used for optimistic locking. Pass the latest value back on update to detect concurrent modifications.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the entitlement was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the entitlement was last updated.

currency_configuration.description: Currency of this entitlement. Inherited from the parent funding source; use to interpret `allocation_balance`.

allocation_balance.description: Updated allocation balance for the project entitlement. Non-negative, with up to 26 digits before the decimal point and 4 after.
